variants: How long do I have to return a product?
Within how many days can I send an item back?
If I want to return something, what is the time limit?
I bought something I don't want. How long have I got to return it?

expected_facts.statement: Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

note: The relation docs/AI_TESTING_STRATEGY.md §1 argued for in prose. Four phrasings, no reference answers, one oracle.

base_question: How long does standard delivery take?
variants: When will my order arrive with normal shipping?
What is the delivery time for the standard option?
If I don't pay for express, how long is the wait?

expected_facts.statement: Standard delivery arrives within 5 to 7 business days.

base_question: How long do I have to report a damaged item?
variants: My package arrived broken. What is the deadline for telling you?
Within how many days must a damaged product be reported?
The item I received is the wrong one. How long do I have to raise it?

expected_facts.statement: A damaged or incorrect item must be reported within 7 days of delivery.
Support runs Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time.

note: polite_prefix is the end-to-end proof of the whole-string-match guarantee in app/services/small_talk.py. A greeting attached to a real question must not be swallowed as small talk.

base_question: How quickly do high priority requests get a first response?

expected_facts.statement: High priority requests get a first response within 4 hours.

variants: What payment methods are supported? I am asking because my previous order was a gift for my brother.
I have been a customer for years and always enjoyed the service. What payment methods are supported?

expected_facts.statement: Credit cards and debit cards are supported.

note: Retrieval embeds the whole question, so irrelevant text dilutes the query vector and can push the answering chunk below relevance_threshold. Invisible to a dataset of clean one-line questions.

variants: What is the return period for items bought from a competitor's website?
What is the warranty period on electronics?
What is the return period under German consumer law?

expected_facts.statement: Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

note: The relation that makes MR01-MR06 mean something. A bot that refuses everything satisfies every invariance relation and fails this one; a bot that answers everything does the reverse. Only a correct bot passes both sets.

variants: What are the support hours on public holidays in Japan?
What is the phone number for the support team?

expected_facts.statement: Support runs Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time.

note: The corpus gives weekday hours and names email plus the portal as the contact channels. Neither variant is answerable from it, and inventing a holiday schedule or a phone number is the exact damage this project exists to prevent.
